Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-210 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText: Grill is excellent - cooks well.  The cast iron grates and all the materials are high quality like everything Weber makes. There are two zones for heat, but the back of the grill is like a third zone because there's another burner along the back and anything you place toward the back cooks/sears faster than the front. The tank mount is a neat contraption, but I'm not sure the tank scale-gauge is really accurate.  Get yourself a tank gauge if you really want to know what's left in the tank,  One shortcoming I discovered was that this particular grill, having the underside of the BBQ open and the grease tray exposed, allows for critters to find and get to the grease tray and even into the BBQ itself - which happened to me. If you have a model with doors under the grill, likely not an issue, but this grill is open on the bottom and the grease tray is vulnerable. Even when covered up, you may have to find a way to deter critters from getting under the grill and exploiting this weakness.  Would be better if there was a critter-proof cage around it or something. But for this price point, the grill is excellent and looks quite durable.
Results.Title: Excellent Grill

I bought this grill in August and I’m so glad I did  My old grill was rusted beyond use. The Weber Spirit II has a cast aluminum(?) body that should end that problem and it’s guaranteed 10 years! The temperature control is very accurate, but is opposite of my old grill. The first spot is high and it goes lower from there. That’s great for preheating, but remember to throttle it back for burgers, fish  and chicken or the inside won’t get cooked through. 
My only complaint is the wheel set up. Two sturdy wheels on the gas tank side allow it to be moved, but lifting on the fold down tray to move the grill causes it to unhook and gives a very unstable feel. I plan to attach casters to the other two stationary legs so I can move it more easily, which I do before and after each use. Hopefully Weber will add the wheels to the next model improvement.

Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-210 Gas Grill
Results.ReviewText:
I have had this grill for about 2 months. I have already grilled more in this past 2 months than I have in my previous 2 years because I enjoy this grill.
Positives:
1. Well built material such as thick grates and the paint appears to hold up to high heat without discoloring.
2. Sturdy not flimsy like my other grills. Thick lid!
3. Disposable grease tray design
Improvements:
1. I smelled propane and found the burner knob was on after grilling. I had read this in a review before buying but ignored it thinking operator probably didn’t turn off completely. I now turn the propane tank off after each use because I worry knob may turn when putting cover on.
2. The side rack is designed to lift grill for moving because I have no front wheels. But, the side rack comes off easily if you hit any bumps such as grass which makes it VERY frustrating. I move it each use from covered porch to grass area to ensure I don’t warp vinyl.
3. Back side of grill cooks hotter than front side. I think this is due to a horizontal burner running the length of backside but not in front side. I think the design intent was this way because of the warming wrack located at back of grill.
I pay attention to small details (perfectionist as my wife calls it) and so far I am happy with grill. Only time can tell :)

Final view of the broken plastic piece

Results.ReviewText: We bought this grill as we downsized after becoming empty nesters.  My husband was thrilled to own a Weber grill.  Shortly after we purchased the grill a storm blew the grill around and one of the tool hooks on a plastic piece of the grill broke off.  We didn’t think it would be such an expense to replace the piece since it was just screwed on to the side tray but were very disappointed to find out we couldn’t get just the plastic piece we had to get the whole $85 side tray!  That seems ridiculous.  If the whole piece would have been made of the same material we wouldn’t have a broken hook.  If they are going to screw a plastic piece on like that why can’t it be purchased separately!! Very frustrating.   Sorry to say Weber grills haven’t received much good press from us for that reason.
